To the commander of the operational group "South"
from Captain Sokolov A.I.
 
REPORT
 
I would like to inform you that on the night of June 13-14, 198_, the personnel of unit 7425-B were on duty at the northern hangars of the warehouse complex.
 
At 02 o'clock.47 min.duty officers recorded a sharp drop in air temperature to +3 °C.At the same time, short-term failures in radio communications and the appearance of interference of an unknown nature were noted.
 
A few minutes later, from the dense fog at a distance of about 40-50 m, an object of a humanoid type, presumably of a female constitution, about 180 cm tall, was visually observed. The object moved silently, did not respond to the commands «Stop» and «Back», and had no signs of weapons.
 
After receiving the order to open firethree rounds were produced.The bullets were reflected at right angles; no traces of hitting the target were recorded.At the time of firing, short-term interruptions in the power supply of the searchlights and distortions in the radio communication channel were observed.
 
Row located at post No. 2.Romanov did not get in touch after the shooting started.During an inspection of the territory at his post, only a service weapon and traces of movement on wet ground were found, leading towards an open area.The fighter himself is missing.
 
On my order, a retreat was made to warehouse No. 3. After turning on the searchlights, the observation object disappeared.Re-discovery was not possible.
 
Personnel losses amount to 4 people.of which:
- 1 person.- missing (row. Romanov S.P.);
- 2 people.- shell-shocked (Efr. Kozlov A.N., row. Belov I.R.);
- 1 person.- woundeasy.(Sergeant Levchenko V.D.).
 
According to preliminary data, the incident is not related to the actions of the enemy or civilians.An anomaly of atmospheric or man-made origin is possible.I consider it necessary to send an engineering and technical commission to check the radiation and electromagnetic background in the area of the complex.
 
Commander of unit 7425-B
Captain Sokolov A.I.
June 14, 198_
